claims.claim: C3.ai sits between foundation-model/compute supply and enterprise operational workflows; its structural value depends on converting generalized AI capability into repeatable governed applications with measurable customer outcomes.

Because cloud vendors, model providers, systems integrators and internal engineering teams can substitute portions of the stack, the successor bottleneck is durable deployment economics and workflow integration rather than access to AI models alone.

causalEdges: AI compute/models -> enterprise application platform -> deployed workflows -> productivity/decision support
weak bookings -> lower future deployment base -> weaker operating leverage
falsifiers: Customers increasingly build equivalent applications directly on hyperscaler/model platforms at lower total cost.
Agreement growth fails to produce durable bookings, revenue expansion or improving operating economics.
unknowns: durability and value of newly signed agreements
realized restructuring savings and post-FY2026 bookings trajectory
